name: akaashg-unity
description: Claude Code plugins for Unity 6 projects. The core plugin is unity-kit; platform packs named unity-kit-<name> depend on it.

plugins.name: unity-kit
plugins.description: Guardrails and workflow for Claude Code in Unity 6 projects: .meta and Library guards, broken-reference and compile gates, build and test fix loops, pre-commit checks, and Unity code and performance reviewers.
